examples.quote: Test why the earlier food-dependent policy-mixture pattern differed between worlds. In each seed block, train one source population using the lower-bottleneck setup: 100 founders in distinct cells, reproductive threshold 80, haploid mutation SD .20, 700-agent cap. Select one panel of eight endpoint policies and use it in every assay cell. Source training is held fixed so the study isolates differences in assay setup, not the origin of the policies. An unavailable source is recorded and blocks that source's planned assays; never replace or silently discard it.
